name: YoFont
summary: Generates installable fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF) from a sentence, with a free 100-glyph plan and paid Starter, Pro and Studio tiers.
description: YoFont generates multi-script typefaces (60 languages, 9 writing systems) from a text prompt, with a glyph editor and TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 export. Annual billing is offered at 20% off. 1 glyph equals 1 drawn character.

pricing.details: Free forever (100 glyphs, preview only; downloads and commercial license not included; fonts are public); Starter 8 €/month (500 glyphs, downloads, no commercial use); Pro 17 €/month (5,000 glyphs); Studio 44 €/month (15,000 glyphs, commercial use, private fonts and API/MCP). Annual billing 20% off (yearly totals not published).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Studio adds commercial use, private fonts and API/MCP
